It’s been a royal affair in Washington, DC this week as King Charles III made his first US state visit. We wrap up some of the highlights of a trip that capitalized on America’s enduring fascination with Britain’s royals.

Video

This weekend marks World Press Freedom day, but there’s little to celebrate as those freedoms are threatened. From my archives, I saw exactly what it looks like when the media is under attack in Moscow in 2007, where Russian journalists were living in fear.

Video

As Israeli settlers continue to attack Palestinians across the occupied West Bank. CNN Producer Abeer Salman reports from Umm al-Khair, where razor wire has blocked Palestinian children from going to school.

Video

"For two hours, she recounted in unflinching details the horrors of the camp. She detailed everything she had seen in Auschwitz- the fate of babies, the fate of children, the fate of women. She spoke of sexual violence. And she was determined to restore names to those who had been reduced to numbers and then to ash."

Best-selling author Natalie Livingstone on the extraordinary story of Marie-Claude Vaillant-Couturier whose testimony at Nuremberg changed the course of history.

She's one of eigh

"Nuremberg is so much more than just courtroom 600, where the trial took place. It was a big ecosystem that comprised of so many women who were there in so many vital roles- translators, witnesses, journalists, artists, lawyers... for some reason these women were marginalized and got sidelined and literally reduced to footnotes in history."

The Nuremberg trials have been well documented, but one vital piece of that story has been missing all these years.

“We are 700 miles away from the US, what happens in Haiti has a direct incidence on what happens in the US.”

Haiti’s Prime Minister Alix Didier Fils-Aimé also urges the Trump administration not to force Haitians to return to his impoverished nation—“the humanitarian outcome should be that those people are not forced to come back to Haiti until we resolve the security issue. Of course, they are Haitians, we will take back all of those citizens.”

Video

“The mission is simple- restore order, bring back economic opportunities and have elections… we have taken back parts of Port-au-Prince, and this is the first time since 2021 that gangs are on the defensive. I am very optimistic”

What’s happening in Haiti is a massively underreported story, a state near total collapse.

The Iranian people continue to face harrowing repression. This week the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights, Volker Türk said he was “appalled that – on top of the already severe impacts of the conflict – the rights of the Iranian people continue to be stripped from them.” At least 21 people have been executed and more than 4,000 arrested on national security-related charges since late February, according to human rights office, OHCHR. “In times of war, threats to human rights increase exponen

“They have all the money in the world, but the one thing that happens is that biology is undefeated.” In the CNN series “Kara Swisher Wants to Live Forever,” the acclaimed tech journalist separates hype from wishful thinking in the Silicon Valley longevity race.

Video

“Escalation is looming large”: as the diplomatic stalemate between Iran the U.S. continues, University of Tehran professor Hassan Ahmadian tells me he believes “time is definitely working to Iran’s favor.”

Video

"I started thinking about guns in America.” I talk to veteran London-based broadcaster @MishalHusain about being at the White House Correspondents' Dinner as shots were fired. “How fortunate we are to live in a country where that kind of threat is thankfully very remote,” she tells me.

Video

“A moment of stability and reassurance”: Veteran British broadcaster @MishalHusain says that, at a difficult time between Washington and London, King Charles managed to seize a complicated diplomatic moment.

Video

"I support Israel and we must continue to support Israel. But there was a slaughter of the Palestinian people in Gaza." On America's relationship with Israel @wendyrsherman tells me, "things have changed, I spend a lot of time with younger people. I try to listen and learn as my parents did with me during the Vietnam war... Israel must be safe and secure and have peace forever. And the Palestinians have to be able to have dignity and a place they can call their own as well."

Video

"I don't think they're fractured. I think they have a very clear sense of what has happened in this war." @vali_nasr gives his take on what Iranian leadership is thinking right now-- "They were willing to talk to President Trump. I think where there is a division is how to respond to his erratic behavior."

Video

"I think the Trump administration is in a very difficult place." @wendyrsherman says-- "I don't think [the blockade] will change the calculus of Iran. It's existential for them. For Donald Trump, it is political. It's markets. It's munitions. And it's the midterms... I believe Donald Trump believes he can sustain this and his other choices-- escalate even further, or declare victory and go away-- are not good choices."

Video

"Russia has turned all its economy into a war machine. It's extremely difficult to turn back." 
When we spoke in Prague, Czech President Petr Pavel warned how President Putin may push his luck in the Baltics, just to humiliate NATO.
